传说之夜（传说之夜（第22页）四目相对，一种难以言明的亲切感莫名产生，叶尘眼眶一热，泪水涌上双眼。这种符篆叫作遁地符，关键时候可以凭它逃命，远遁到附近不远的地方。但魔力的恢复速度与上限是由身体的疲劳程度决定的，每一次轮班，人偶使们的魔力上限就会降低些许。陈卿青漂浮在空中，淡定地看着前方的虎神皇，此时虎神皇挨了陈卿青一掌，原本因为秘法而膨胀的身体如同泄了气的气球一般，回归了原来的体型。等待的滋味真的是太难受了，尤其是空等的时候，寒风呼呼的吹来，而安秀儿因为错过他，却是哪里也不敢去。眼看着自己弟弟的手要碰到儿子了，长娥也不知道哪里来的力气，一下子就窜了起来，将自己的弟弟推到在地，好巧不巧撞在了门框上，一个不留意，竟然就这么昏过去了。蝴蝶谷，是唐僧和她假结婚的地方，一想到那一夜洞房，唐僧就悔恨交加。此事大家都认同，这些堪石师再出来的时候，安秀儿就觉得他们的精神面貌变的更之前不一样了，看起来更有生机了一些，对于此，安秀儿乐见其成，希望下一次，他们的实力能够有所提升。蒙面人显然有些吃瘪，不由冷哼一声，身体幻作一阵青烟，正欲遁逃而去。“这任务并不好完成，你怎么就领取了这样的任务？”叶凡说道。顿时，宋海不由的一愣，也不知道为什么，总舵那边突然就增加了一个行使位置，而这个行使，就是林城。宴心浅笑，将自己的想法慢慢托出，毕竟这些还只是一个雏形，具体实施的怎么样还要看之后的实践。

Legendary Night (Page 22) Their eyes met each other, and an indescribable feeling of intimacy arose inexplicably. Ye Chen's eyes were hot, and tears welled up in his eyes. This kind of talisman is called the Earth Escape Talisman. At critical moments, you can use it to escape from afar. Not far away. However, the recovery speed and upper limit of magic power are determined by the degree of fatigue of the body. Every shift, the upper limit of magic power of the puppet masters will be lowered a little. Chen Qingqing was floating in the air, looking calmly at the Tiger God Emperor in front of him. At this time, the Tiger God Emperor received a palm from Chen Qingqing. His body, which had been swollen by the secret technique, returned to its original shape like a deflated balloon. The feeling of waiting was really uncomfortable, especially when the cold wind was blowing while waiting. It blew, but An Xiuer didn't dare to go anywhere because she missed him. Seeing that her brother's hand was about to touch her son, Chang'e didn't know where she got the strength, and she jumped up and pushed her brother to the ground. What a coincidence. She accidentally bumped into the door frame and passed out without paying attention. Butterfly Valley was the place where Tang Seng and her had a fake marriage. Thinking of that night, Tang Seng felt regretful. Everyone agreed that when these Kanshi masters came out again, An Xiuer felt that their mental outlook was different from before, and they looked more energetic. An Xiuer was happy to see this, and hoped that their strength would be improved next time. Feeling a little defeated, he couldn't help but snorted, and his body turned into a puff of smoke, and he was about to run away. "This task is not easy to complete, why did you receive such a task?" Ye Fan said. Suddenly, Song Hai couldn't help but wonder, and for some reason, an operation position was suddenly added to the general helm, and this operation was Lin Cheng. Yanxin smiled and slowly expressed his ideas. After all, these are just prototypes. How they will be implemented depends on the actual practice.
